programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

(Thriller, Comedy) - 1990

(Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1984

But when the ghosts turn on the judge, he issues an order allowing the Ghostbusters to get back to work. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1989

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Paranormal researcher Abby Yates and physicist Erin Gilbert are trying to prove that ghosts exist in modern society. When strange apparitions appear in Manhattan, Gilbert and Yates turn to engineer Jillian Holtzmann for help. Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 2016

programme.desc: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat. (Musical, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2007

programme.title: Hush... Hush, Sweet Charlotte
programme.desc: Forty years ago, on the night they were meant to elope, Charlotte Hollis (Bette Davis) found her lover decapitated during a party, the blood on her dress leading everyone to suspect she was the murderer. Now, in 1964, Charlotte is an old recluse and must fight to keep her home. She enlists the help of her cousin Velma (Olivia de Havilland), who was there at the time of the murder. However, soon after Velma's arrival, Charlotte's mind becomes unstable, and she starts seeing her dead lover's head. (Horror) - 1965

programme.title: Leave Her to Heaven
programme.desc: While on a train, writer Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) strikes up a relationship with the gorgeous Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney). Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable. (Crime drama) - 1945

programme.title: Laura

On the trail of her murderer, McPherson quizzes Laura's arrogant best friend, gossip columnist Waldo Lydecker (Clifton Webb) and her comparatively mild fiancé, Shelby Carpenter (Vincent Price). As the detective grows obsessed with the case, he finds himself falling in love with the dead woman. (Mystery) - 1944

programme.title: The Lodger

The Burtons' niece, Kitty (Merle Oberon), is a music hall singer who initially grows fond of the eccentric lodger, but, when the Ripper's body count rises, she and a Scotland Yard inspector (George Sanders) gradually begin to suspect that Slade could be the notorious Whitechapel killer. (Thriller) - 1944

programme.title: Nightmare Alley

But when Pete dies, Zeena is forced to take on Stanton as a partner, and he quickly proves more gifted than his predecessor. Ambitious to a fault, Carlisle abandons Zeena and the carny to reinvent himself as The Great Stanton, wowing high-class audiences in a Chicago hotel. (Crime drama) - 1947

Nelson), Diane (JoBeth Williams), teenaged Dana (Dominique Dunne), eight-year-old Robbie (Oliver Robins), and five-year-old Carol Ann (Heather O'Rourke) -- when ghosts commune with them through the television set. Initially friendly and playful, the spirits turn unexpectedly menacing, and, when Carol Ann goes missing, Steve and Diane turn to a parapsychologist and eventually an exorcist for help. (Horror, Thriller) - 1982

programme.title: The Exorcist
programme.desc: One of the most profitable horror movies ever made, this tale of an exorcism is based loosely on actual events. When young Regan (Linda Blair) starts acting odd -- levitating, speaking in tongues -- her worried mother (Ellen Burstyn) seeks medical help, only to hit a dead end. A local priest (Jason Miller), however, thinks the girl may be seized by the devil. The priest makes a request to perform an exorcism, and the church sends in an expert (Max von Sydow) to help with the difficult job. (Horror) - 1973

programme.title: Support Your Local Sheriff
programme.desc: A small-scale gold rush erupts in a Colorado town after treasure is found in a grave. The area quickly becomes a magnet for criminals and other ne'er-do-wells, but everyone is too intent on searching for gold to consider law and order. When Jason McCullough (James Garner), a clever and supremely laid-back gunslinger, wanders into town, he becomes the de facto lawman, aided by local eccentric Jake (Jack Elam). McCullough's ingenuity is tested, however, when he runs afoul of the tough Danby gang. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

programme.title: Chato's Land
programme.desc: Half-Apache Pardon Chato (Charles Bronson) finds himself in a bar fight with a bigoted sheriff and kills the man to save his own life. The locals won't accept this defense, though, and angry Civil War veteran Quincey Whitmore (Jack Palance) rounds up a gang of toughs to track down Chato, who is forced to flee the scene. But when the posse finds Chato's family and brutalizes them, the escapee decides it's time to stop running and start taking revenge on the lynch mob. (Western) - 1972

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: Fleeing the scene of a gruesome gunfight in Mexico, Billy Young (Robert Walker) arrives in the small town of Lordsburg, where he is promptly deputized by local sheriff Ben Kane (Robert Mitchum). Kane takes the troubled young man under his wing, hoping to reform his lawless ways. As the bond between the two men grows stronger, Kane recruits Young for a particularly personal assignment: to help bring to justice Frank Boone (John Anderson), a vicious outlaw responsible for the death of his son. (Western) - 1969

programme.title: The Long Riders
programme.desc: During a bank robbery by the legendary James-Younger Gang, Ed Miller (Dennis Quaid) impulsively kills a man, much to the displeasure of leader Jesse James (James Keach), who insists that the gang scatter until the heat is off. The groups of brothers go their separate ways, with Cole Younger (David Carradine) considering settling down with his feisty girlfriend, Belle Starr (Pamela Reed). But they soon regroup for an ill-fated bank job in Northfield, Minn., that results in an epic chase. (Western, Biography) - 1980

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Quirt Evans (John Wayne), a cowboy on the run, is injured when his horse stumbles near a Quaker family's land. The family takes him in as he regains his health, and he falls for their young daughter, Penelope (Gail Russell). As Quirt falls deeper in love and becomes accustomed to the family's peaceful ways, his violent past starts to catch up to him. Eventually he is forced to decide whether it is worth letting go of his turbulent former life for his future with Penelope. (Western) - 1947

programme.title: Keeping Mum
programme.desc: Walter Goodfellow (Rowan Atkinson), vicar of the British village Little Wallop, is busy composing the perfect sermon. So busy, in fact, that he fails to notice his bored wife's (Kristin Scott Thomas) flirtation with her American golf instructor (Patrick Swayze), his daughter's revolving set of boyfriends, or his son's status as the favorite target of bullies. Enter Grace Hawkins (Maggie Smith), the new housekeeper, who has a drastic solution to the family's problems. (Dark comedy) - 2006

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice. (Comedy drama) - 2012

programme.title: Closing the Ring
programme.desc: During the 1940s, a group of young men go off to war, leaving behind Ethel Ann (Mischa Barton), who is in love with one of them, Teddy. In modern-day Belfast, a man named Jimmy (Martin McCann) endeavors to return a ring found in the wreckage of a crashed plane. He travels to Michigan, where the grown Ethel Ann (Shirley MacLaine), who married another man after Teddy was killed in battle, now lives. Ethel Ann must decide whether to go with Jimmy to meet the soldier who last saw Teddy alive. (Drama, Romance) - 2007

programme.title: Black Sheep
programme.desc: Sheep-fearing Henry (Nathan Meister) returns to his brother's (Peter Feeney) New Zealand farm, hoping his sibling will buy out his share of the property. However, what he finds are genetically altered sheep that prey on humans and turn their victims into undead, woolly killers. Shear madness ensues as Henry, an animal-rights activist (Danielle Mason) and a farmhand (Tammy Davis) set out to stop the rampaging animals. (Horror, Comedy) - 2006

programme.desc: High-school senior Malcolm (Shameik Moore) and his friends Jib (Tony Revolori) and Diggy (Kiersey Clemons) bond over '90s hip-hop culture, their studies and playing music in their own punk band. A chance encounter with a drug dealer named Dom lands Malcolm and company at the dealer's nightclub birthday party; when the scene turns violent, they flee -- with the Ecstasy that Dom secretly hid in Malcolm's backpack. A wild adventure ensues as the youths try to evade armed thugs who want the stash. (Comedy) - 2015

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: Panic strikes Jane Hammond (Natalie Portman) when her outlaw husband John returns to their farm with bullet wounds. (Western) - 1958

Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area. (Western) - 1946

programme.title: Pioneer Justice
programme.desc: Something strange is going on in the frontier town of Buffalo Gap. After two men turn up dead, a marshal named Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) arrives, along with his partner, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), to investigate. Although the outlaw Bill Judd (Jack Ingram) seems to be behind the deaths, the sheriff is not taking any action. When Cheyenne learns the sheriff may be taking orders from another party, he and Fuzzy try to find out who is controlling the criminal element. (Western) - 1947

programme.title: Romance of the West

The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time. (Western) - 1946

programme.title: The Tioga Kid

For Eddie, the theft comes as a shock, as it may have been perpetrated by his twin, who is known as "the Tioga Kid" (also Dean). Suddenly, the brothers are at odds as never before. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy. (Western) - 1948

programme.title: The Dawn Rider

Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated. (Western) - 1935

When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad). Before long, they stumble onto a plot by a well-known football magnate (Noble Willingham) to bribe federal legislators into legalizing sports gambling. (Action) - 1991

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Russia in Afghanistan

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: S01 E10 Big Picture: The United Nations Offensive A look at the 1950 attacks against the Communist army in Korea by United Nations' forces.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: S01 E13 Progress to Peace The pacification and Vietnamization efforts of the U.S. Army in Vietnam.

programme.title: My Grandparents' War

programme.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
programme.desc: S01 E05 Fighting Further Afield (October - December 1940) Tracking the main events of WWII with the help of archive footage; learning about Pearl Harbor, The Battle of Britain, D-Day, the dropping of the atomic bomb, and more; from the early battles right through to the complexities of the endgame.

programme.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
programme.desc: S01 E06 On Land, In the Air and All at Sea (January - March 1941) The Luftwaffe continues its attempts to bomb Britain into submission; the German Afrika Korps strengthens its position as Rommel, Hitler's "Desert Fox", takes charge; at sea, naval forces battle each other and the elements.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: S01 E03 Newsreel Reports on Preparation for D-Day Prefabricated concrete barges are manufactured in preparation for D-Day, and U.S. troops storm a beach in a practice landing assault; a look at how harbor facilities, which were made in England, were used in the Normandy invasion.

programme.title: Visions of War: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Invasion of Southern France The invasion of Southern France and the subsequent junction with the American army in northwest France.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: S01 E01 The Hitler Youth: Nazi Child Army In the 1930s Germany, the Hitler Youth indoctrinated children to become loyal soldiers for Hitler; tracing its rise, from early propaganda to wartime mobilization.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: S01 E04 Big Picture: A Nation Builds Under Fire How the people of the Republic of Vietnam attempted to build a nation amidst the holocaust of war.

programme.title: WWI the War to End All Wars, Part 1: The Valley of Death
programme.desc: During a time of apparent tranquility and peace, the buildup to World War I was deceptively quiet, but chaos and carnage arrived swiftly.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: S01 E06 Ambassadors in Berlin: The Whistleblowers of WWII In 1933, Hitler rose to power and the Nazis seized control; foreign diplomats in Berlin witnessed the regime's rise and Jewish persecution-but their warnings went unheeded.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: S01 E05 Nazi Creatures Hitler, Göring and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology and even weapons of war; far beyond affection, their fascination fueled pseudo-scientific projects and genetic manipulation.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: S02 E15 Big Picture: Third Korean Winter Depicting soldiers' daily living in the Korean War during the winter period 1952-53.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: S01 E15 Good Bye Vietnam The story of the last hours of the Fall of Saigon.

programme.desc: Land the Landing Force Visions of War: U.S. Marines

programme.desc: S02 E04 The Battle of the Caucasus An attack on Soviet oil fields could have led to a victory, but resistance thwarted Hitler's dream.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: The concentration camp deportees became the rare witnesses to mass extermination.

programme.title: Seasonal Wonderlands

programme.title: Seasonal Wonderlands
programme.desc: S01 E03 Okavango The Okavango Delta is a lush wetland of islands and lagoons in the middle of the vast, featureless Kalahari Desert.

programme.title: Big Bear Diary
programme.desc: S01 E01 Follow the trials and tribulations of North America's bears as they struggle to survive in an increasingly hostile world.

programme.title: Big Bear Diary
programme.desc: S01 E02 The conflict between black bear mothers Jeannie and Katie continue as Jeannie besieges Katie's two cubs in a tree; Brown bear mother Blondie and her three cubs make the most of carrion washed up by the sea.

programme.title: Big Bear Diary
programme.desc: S01 E03 Brown bear mum Blondie and her cubs were last seen fleeing from a pack of wolves. Have they survived? Both the black and polar bear families have trouble with marauding males.

programme.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me
programme.desc: Meet the Wolfpack In an attempt to improve the understanding of wild wolves, Gordon Buchanan travels to the remote Canadian Arctic in search of wolves that have never seen humans before.

programme.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me
programme.desc: S01 E01 Survival of the Pups Gordon Buchanan uses his skills as a wildlife cameraman to gain the trust of a white wolf family; as spring turns to summer, he becomes accepted by the pack, including mother Luna and her three newborn pups.

programme.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me
programme.desc: S01 E02 Big Bad Wolves Gordon Buchanan reunites with his white wolf family as they try to raise their pups and prepare for winter; he walks with wolves as they hunt lemmings, muskox and hares and encounter a rival pack.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Battle to Save the Tiger Investigating India's growing problem with tiger poaching; tiger scientist turned whistleblower, Raghu uncovers the scale of the problem.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Nature's Biggest Beasts How the world's biggest beasts overcome the challenges of their size.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: The Dragon's Bite Dr. Bryan Fry discovers there's a lot more to the Komodo dragon than meets the eye - from hidden venom glands to its secret origins.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Highgrove: A Prince's Legacy Charting a year in the running of Highgrove, home to the Prince of Wales, who takes an active part in the management of the organic garden and estate.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Super Fast Falcon The peregrine falcon is the fastest animal on Earth; but what does it take to be a high-speed record breaker?

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Lobo: The Wolf That Changed America See how a man's mission to kill a wolf had a lasting impact on wilderness preservation.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Attenborough's Ark David Attenborough chooses ten animals that he would most like to save from extinction.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Five Big Cats and a Camera The lives of cheetahs, leopards, servals, caracals and lions.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Echo of the Elephants: The Next Generation The elephant calf Ely is followed for four years through Kenya's Amboseli National Park.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Bowerbirds: The Art of Seduction David Attenborough travels to the remote highlands of New Guinea and the rainforests of Australia to explore the world of the bowerbird, a creature which flaunts its charms, steals for its own purposes and indulges in spiteful acts.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: The Bat Man of Mexico Featuring the story of Rodrigo Medellin, who has dedicated his life to saving bats.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Weasels: Feisty and Fearless Delve into the adventures of first-time stoat mum Bandita as she raises her kits in a unique weasel wonderland, with over 50 hidden cameras; cameras capture a half-ounce orphaned least weasel called Twiz embarking on her journey back to the wild.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Lions: Pride in Peril A film following the Tokitok pride of lions in Tanzania's breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Attenborough's Wonder of Eggs David Attenborough shares his passion for birds' eggs, from their ability to nurture new life, to their strength to withstand the weight of an incubating parent and their potential to allow a chick to break free.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
programme.desc: S01 E01 Rachel explores Melbourne's Chinatown, tastes some of the cities infamous coffee and checks out the new type of restaurant taking over Australia's food-loving capital.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
programme.desc: S01 E02 Rachel pays a visit to a century-old milk bar and a bar serving up some twists on Aussie classics before meeting up with Kate Gibbs, the granddaughter of legendary Aussie cook Margaret Fulton.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
programme.desc: S01 E03 Rachel explores some of the city's outer edges, where she discovers authentic and tasty croissants, before meeting up with seasonal cooking advocate Matt Wilkinson.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
programme.desc: S01 E04 Rachel takes a trip to the Bellarine Peninsula, an up-and-coming foodies' paradise, where she meets up with a mussel trawler, winery owner and cheese maker.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
programme.desc: S01 E05 Rachel shines a spotlight on Melbourne's sport fanatics' favorite gourmet fast food and cooks up a storm with the city's original food truck proprietor.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
programme.desc: S01 E06 Keen to explore this melting pot of cuisines, Rachel explores a Vietnamese food market, tracks down a suburban hot bed of Greek eats, and learns how to make passata from an Italian-Australian nonna.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
programme.desc: S01 E07 Rachel explores one of the lesser-known regions on Melbourne's doorstep, the Dandenongs, where she meets up with Argentinian chef Mauro Callegari.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
programme.desc: S01 E08 On her last few days in Melbourne, Rachel takes a look at the city's current and future food trends and throws a barbecue party for the foodies she has met during her time in Australia.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
programme.desc: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
programme.desc: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
programme.desc: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
programme.desc: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
programme.desc: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
programme.desc: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: S02 E01 Shellfish Chef Blanc celebrates the best of British shellfish as he cooks dishes including Moules Marinière, seared squid salad and Scottish lobster.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: S02 E05 Charcuterie Chef Raymond shares his love of charcuterie, beginning with thin slices of duck cured in herbs and juniper berries; also, he makes a chicken liver parfait and a meaty pot-au-feu medley; lastly, a ham hock terrine served with home-made pickles.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: S02 E06 Spices and Chillies Drawing upon his travels through Asia, Raymond creates dishes full of fragrant spice and fiery heat.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E01 San Francisco to Monterey Rick enjoys sitting on the dock of the bay in San Francisco, tasting legendary dishes like the hangtown fry; San Francisco is also the home of sourdough and where America's love affair with seasonal cooking took hold.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E02 Monterey to San Diego Rick Stein continues traveling down the Californian coastline immortalized by Steinbeck.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E03 San Diego to Baja California Rick enjoys a hearty steak and eggs American diner special and bids a fond farewell to his trusty Ford Mustang as he heads across what is reputed to be the busiest border crossing in the world.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E04 Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Rick lands in the town that gave the world tequila and the metropolis that birthed mariachis and dishes like chili con carne.

programme.title: The Next Karate Kid
programme.desc: Karate master Mr. Miyagi goes to Boston to attend a military reunion. There, he visits with Louisa, the widow of his former commander, and meets her granddaughter, Julie. Julie's parents were recently killed in a car accident, and she is still reeling from the loss. When Julie surprises Miyagi with her knowledge of karate, he takes her to a Buddhist monastery for training and to help her come to terms with her angst. (Drama, Family, Martial arts, Movie) - 1994-12-17

programme.title: Fun With Dick and Jane
programme.desc: After Dick Harper (Jim Carrey) loses his job at Globodyne in an Enron-esque collapse, he and his wife, Jane (Téa Leoni), turn to crime in order to handle the massive debt they now face. Two intelligent people, Dick and Jane actually get pretty good at robbing people and even enjoy it -- but they have second thoughts when they're reminded that crime can hurt innocent people. When the couple hears that Globodyne boss Jack McCallister (Alec Baldwin) actually swindled the company, they plot revenge. (Comedy, Crime drama, Movie, Romance) - 2005-12-21

programme.title: The Interview
programme.desc: Dave Skylark (James Franco) and his producer Aaron Rapoport (Seth Rogen) are the team behind the popular tabloid-TV show "Skylark Tonight." After learning that North Korea's Kim Jong-un (Randall Park) is a huge fan of the show, they successfully set up an interview with him, hoping to legitimize themselves as actual journalists. However, as Dave and Aaron prepare for their journey to Pyongyang, the CIA steps in, recruits them, and assigns them an incredible mission: Assassinate the dictator. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Movie) - 2014-12-25

programme.title: Did You Hear About the Morgans?
programme.desc: New Yorkers Paul (Hugh Grant) and Meryl (Sarah Jessica Parker) Morgan seem to have it all -- except that their marriage is crumbling around them. But their romantic woes are small compared to the trouble they find themselves in after witnessing a murder. To protect them from an assassin, federal agents whisk away Paul and Meryl to a small town in Wyoming, where their marriage will crash and burn, or their passion will reignite. (Comedy, Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2009-12-18

programme.title: Life Without Dick
programme.desc: After consulting a fortuneteller, painter Colleen (Sarah Jessica Parker) begins to suspect that her private-eye boyfriend, Dick (Johnny Knoxville), is cheating. When she comes home and finds him packing to leave her, Colleen accidentally kills him. Nervous Irish Mafia hit man Daniel (Harry Connick Jr.), who's been gunning for Dick, arrives shortly afterward and admits he has never successfully completed a job. Daniel proposes to take credit for the murder, and the odd couple fall in love. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2001

programme.title: I Dreamed of Africa

Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton. programme.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
programme.desc: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage. programme.title: Galaxmphony - Die finale Odyssee
programme.desc: Das DR Symphonieorchester sprengt die Schallmauer und entführt Sie in ferne Galaxien - an einen Ort, der zwischen Realität und Fantasie liegt, mit Soundtracks von Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune und vielen anderen. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2025-10-18

programme.title: Schostakowitsch - 24 Präludien und Fugen, Op. 87
programme.desc: Der Pianist David Levy spielt die 24 Präludien und Fugen, Op. 87, von Dmitri Schostakowitsch. Der Komponist ließ sich dazu von Bachs "Wohltemperiertem Klavier" inspirieren. Das Konzert fand 2023 im Budapest Music Center statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-04-05

programme.title: Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 und Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 7
programme.desc: Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in diesem Konzert. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur, KV 338. Diese Sinfonie war die letzte, die Mozart in Salzburg als Hofmusiker schrieb. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-10-18

programme.title: Teatro Regio - Hinter den Kulissen
programme.desc: Das Teatro Regio wurde 1740 mit der Aufführung eines Werkes von Francesco Feo eröffnet. Eine Blütezeit erlebte das Haus von 1895 bis 1898 unter der Leitung von Arturo Toscanini. 1896 fand dort die Uraufführung von Puccinis "La Bohème" statt. (Special, Documentary, Music, Classical, Opera) - 2017-06-01

programme.title: Hollywood-Gala - Preisverleihungsnacht
programme.desc: Das Dänische Nationale Sinfonieorchester und der Konzertchor entführen Sie auf eine musikalische Reise durch die größten Oscar-prämierten Filme. (Special, Music) - 2026-09-12

programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) spielt Mozarts 5. Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus, Op. 90 von Franz Schubert. Prosseda bringt das Konzert mit einer Interpretation des technisch anspruchsvollen Ballade No. 4, Op. 52 von Chopin zu einem krönenden Abschluss. Er ist besonders für seine Interpretationen einiger kürzlich entdeckter Werke von Mendelssohn und seine 9-teilige CD-Serie über Klavierwerke des Komponisten bekannt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-12-15

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-06

programme.title: Bach - 6. Brandenburgisches Konzert
programme.desc: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 6 in B-Dur, BWV 1051. Im Gegensatz zu den anderen Konzerten gibt es in diesem Stück keine Geigen. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-18

programme.title: Werke von Beethoven und Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Im Jahr 2021 feiert Martha Argerich ihren 80. Geburtstag mit einem Konzert im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich. Bei diesem Konzert wird Argerich von dem Cellisten Mischa Maisky, dem Geiger Maxim Vengerov und dem Pianisten Iddo Bar-Shaï begleitet. (Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-12-06

programme.title: Ueda -- Someone Out There Is Praying for Peace I
programme.desc: Andrea Vitello dirigiert die Komposition "Someone Out There is Praying for Peace" der zeitgenössischen Komponistin Rita Ueda. Das Werk ist für Streicher und Tar, ein traditionelles Zupfinstrument der persischen Musik, geschrieben. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-10-01

programme.title: Wer hat das Boléro von Maurice Ravel gestohlen?
programme.desc: In der Dokumentation wird der Rechtsstreit um das Musikstück Boléro untersucht. Das Stück wird von Maurice Ravel im Jahr 1928 komponiert und dieser gibt die Rechte an seinen Bruder Edouard. Dieser stirbt 1960 und löst den Rechtsstreit aus. (Special, Documentary) - 2016-05-01

programme.title: Beethoven - Klaviersonate Nr. 21 - III
programme.desc: Julijana Sarac spielt den dritten Satz aus Ludwig van Beethovens Klaviersonate Nr. 21. (Special, Music) - 2023-05-02

programme.title: Hans van Manen: Moving to Music
programme.desc: Reflexionen von Freunden und Kollegen, die Details der Choreographie von Hans van Manen enthüllen. (Special, Documentary, Dance, Ballet)

programme.title: Bach - Sonate Nr. 2 BWV 1015
programme.desc: Die Sonate Nr. 2 BWV 1018 ist die zweite von Bachs Sonaten, die vor 1725 komponiert wurden. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-07-04

programme.title: Holst - Die Planeten
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen dirigiert die Sinfonia Rotterdam und den Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in einer Aufführung von Gustav Holsts The Planets, Op. 32, aufgenommen in De Doelen, Rotterdam, im Jahr 2019. Van Alphen gründete Sinfonia Rotterdam im Jahr 2000. (Special, Performing arts) - 2007-04-26

programme.title: Werke für Violine und Klavier: Corelli, Ravel u.a
programme.desc: Der japanische Geiger Naoya Nishimura und der italienische Pianist Andrea Bacchetti präsentieren ein intimes Recital, das in der Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan, aufgenommen wurde. Diese Aufführung wurde am 22. Juni 2019 aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-01-01

programme.title: Schumann - 1. Klaviersonate in fis-Moll, op. 11
programme.desc: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Schwartz Schumanns Klaviersonate Nr. 1 in fis-Moll, op. 11. Schumann vollendete das Werk im Jahr 1835 und widmete es seiner Geliebten Clara Wieck. Da er sie nicht sehen durfte, schickte er Clara die Sonate anonym. (Special) - 2024-01-30

programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Der belgische Dirigent Jos van Immerseel leitet Anima Eterna Brugge in einem Konzertprogramm, das dem amerikanischen Komponisten George Gershwin gewidmet ist. Die Aufführung wurde am 3. März 2017 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-02-12

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade Nr. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Der Musiker Roberto Giordano interpretiert Chopins Ballade Nr. 1, Op. 23. Bereits aus 1831 stammen erste Entwürfe dieses Werks. Der Komponist hielt sich damals in Wien auf. Jedoch wurde die erste Ballade erst 1835 in Paris vollendet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-06-12

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: Anlässlich des 100-jährigen Jubiläums der magischen Geschichte um die russische Großfürstin Anastasia bringt das kanadische Ballett Jörgen 2019 ihre zehn Jahre alte Produktion zurück auf die Bühne! "Anastasia" wurde vom gefeierten Choreografen und künstlerischen Leiter Bengt Jörgen kreiert und ist mit einer originalen Orchesterpartitur des Komponisten Ivan Barbotin unterlegt. (Special, Music) - 2021-08-19

programme.title: Werke von Smetana, Janáček, Suk und Dvořák
programme.desc: Mit diesem Kammermusikprogramm zollen die Musiker der Reina Sofía Musikschule in Madrid der Musik der größten tschechischen Komponisten Tribut. Auf dem Programm stehen Werke von Smetana, Janáček, Dvořák und Suk. Das Konzert fand am 28.11.2024 statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-23

programme.title: Mahler, Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur
programme.desc: Die Wiener Philharmoniker unter der Leitung von Leonard Bernstein spielen die Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur von Gustav Mahler (1860-1911). Diese Aufnahme entstand im Oktober 1974 im Wiener Konzerthaus. Als erster Dirigent nahm Leonard Bernstein alle Symphonien Gustav Mahlers nicht nur auf Schallplatte, sondern auch auf Video auf. Bernsteins Mahler-Zyklus ist ein einzigartiges musikalisches Dokument und trug zu einem neuen Verständnis von Mahlers Werk bei. (Special, Music) - 2012-12-06

programme.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
programme.desc: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-01-03

programme.title: Bach - 3. Sonate für Violin (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Isabelle Faust spielt zwei unglaubliche Solowerke für Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für Violine des Komponisten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-05-31
